__schema.description: Per-Pokémon availability overrides. Resolver default: each Pokémon is obtainable in every game whose `acceptsFromGens` matches the Pokémon's origin generation. Each game currently accepts only its own generation, so cross-gen availability (e.g. Pikachu in FRLG or HGSS) needs explicit `addedIn` overrides. This keeps the UI showing only verified data.

fields.exclusiveTo: Pokémon is ONLY in these game ids. Replaces the default.
fields.addedIn: Extra game ids beyond the default. Use this to declare cross-gen availability (e.g. Pikachu in FRLG).
fields.removedFrom: Game ids to remove from the default (e.g. version-exclusive cross-pairs).
fields.event: true if the Pokémon's normal acquisition is via event distribution. UI shows an 'Event' chip.
